One day, as the year drew to a close, 
Tokai Teio headed to Nakayama Racecourse 
to watch Symboli Rudolf compete in the 
Arima Kinen.

Catching a glimpse of Symboli Rudolf's 
overwhelming run, Tokai Teio felt 
firsthand the immense gulf in ability 
separating her from her idol.

Even so, her desire to stand alongside 
Symboli Rudolf remains unchanged.

Fully aware of the arduous road ahead, 
Tokai Teio reaffirmed her resolve that she 
would never, ever give up.
